  "number": 98,
  "title": "Multi-browser living-room E2E: host + remote + TV + 2 players",
  "body": "## Summary

Add a **full Playwright multi-browser E2E** that plays through a real multiplayer game with four concurrent clients:

| Role | Browser context | Surface |
|---|---|---|
| Host | Chromium A (signed-in Clerk) | `/game/host/$gameId` (classic and/or Remote shell when TV connected) |
| TV | Chromium B (unauthenticated) | `/game/tv/$gameId` |
| Player 1 | Chromium C (player session) | `/game/$code` join → player round UI |
| Player 2 | Chromium D (player session) | same |
| Remote (optional 5th, or reuse host-as-remote) | Chromium E or host tab | `/r/$token` public Remote |

Goal: catch integration bugs that single-surface visual goldens cannot — pairing, presence, break mode, audible authority, round progression, and cross-client sync — in one scripted living-room night.

Related: [#92](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/92) (TV), [#94](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/94) (Remote), [#97](https://github.com/matemolnar8/cigster/issues/97) (WebRTC media room / presence).

## Why

Today `e2e/visual/*` seeds Convex state and screenshots **one surface at a time**. That is excellent for CSS/layout, but it does not prove:

- TV heartbeat / `tvConnected` flips host UI (Remote shell, mute)
- Players can join via code/QR while TV lobby is up
- Host/Remote actions advance rounds that players and TV observe
- Break mode pauses TV audio and blocks round mutations
- Closing TV returns usable host audio (once #97 lands: peer disconnect; today: heartbeat TTL)
- Remote token auth works from a public `/r/$token` page without Clerk

A multi-context Playwright suite is the right place for that contract.

## Scope (happy path — one full round minimum)

### Setup

1. Seed or create: host Clerk user, set with enough songs for ≥1 round, create game (or use `seedHost` + live mutations).
2. Open **four** browser contexts in one test (serial, single worker):
   - Host (Clerk)
   - TV (`game.tvPath`)
   - Player Alex + Player Blair (join by code; inject or complete join UI)

Optional fifth: public Remote via `game.remotePath` (if host stays classic, or after host prefers classic).

### Flow to automate

1. **Lobby**
   - TV shows join code / QR
   - Both players join and appear on host + TV roster
   - Host starts game
2. **Round playing**
   - TV shows listening stage; host/remote can skip or wait for placement
   - At least one player places a guess (or host drives to resolving via existing host actions if player place is flaky under stubs)
3. **Reveal / award**
   - Host/Remote reveals and awards
   - TV shows reveal + standings (transport controls must not block scores)
4. **Break (if shipped)**
   - Host/Remote enters break → TV scoreboard + join QR; round mutations rejected
   - Resume → continue
5. **TV disconnect**
   - Close TV context → host becomes / stays operable (mute off when TV gone; Remote shell may leave)
6. **Finish**
   - End or complete enough rounds to reach a stable finished/between state and assert key UI on remaining clients

YouTube: reuse `installYouTubeIframeApiStub` / thumbnail stubs so CI does not depend on real YouTube.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)

- [ ] New Playwright spec (e.g. `e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts` or `e2e/e2e/living-room.spec.ts`) runs **multiple browser contexts** in one test
- [ ] Covers host + TV + ≥2 distinct player sessions through lobby → in-round → reveal/award
- [ ] Asserts cross-client visibility (player join reflected on host/TV; host action reflected on players/TV)
- [ ] Includes Remote **or** host-as-remote path with TV connected (mute / shell behavior)
- [ ] Exercises break enter/resume if break mode remains in product
- [ ] Exercises TV tab close → host continues
- [ ] Uses Clerk test users + Convex local (same Docker visual harness or a sibling Compose target)
- [ ] Deterministic under YouTube stubs; no reliance on real network media
- [ ] Documented how to run locally / in CI (`pnpm test:…`); not required to be a screenshot golden suite (assertions > pixels)
- [ ] Flake budget: retries allowed, but root-cause sleeps/races called out in the PR

## Non-goals

- Replacing the visual golden matrix
- Perfect A/V sync timing assertions (until #97); assert commands/UI state instead
- Load / stress testing many concurrent games

## Implementation notes

- Prefer Playwright `browser.newContext()` × N over separate projects so one test owns the whole night
- Worker-scoped Clerk host via `extendClerkUsers`; players via session seed / join UI
- Reuse `e2e/seed/host.ts` paths (`hostPath`, `tvPath`, `remotePath`, `code`) where possible; may need “live” mutations mid-test instead of fully pre-seeded round states
- Keep suite **serial** and isolated (unique host subject / reset) to avoid seed races already fixed on this branch
- Gate in CI behind the existing visual Docker job or a dedicated `e2e-live` job with the same Clerk secrets

## Open questions

- Minimum bar: one round vs full game-to-finished?
- Is public `/r/$token` required in v1, or is host-as-remote + TV enough?
- Should this run on every PR or nightly (runtime / flake cost)?",
  "state": "closed",
  "user": {
    "login": "matemolnar8"
  }
}
